SCENE 01 — THE GREAT WIFI QUESTION (10 SECONDS)

VIDEO PROMPT:
Create a funny, energetic 10-second 3D animated family-comedy video set in a cozy modern Indian living room. Maintain the same characters throughout all three clips: a cute, expressive 3-year-old Indian boy with chubby cheeks, big curious brown eyes, short neatly combed black hair, wearing a yellow T-shirt and blue shorts; his Indian mother in a simple pastel kurta; and his Indian father in a casual T-shirt and track pants. Warm, colorful, high-quality family-friendly 3D animation, expressive facial acting, natural Hindi lip-sync, playful comic timing.

ACTION & DIALOGUE:
0–2 sec: The boy marches into the living room holding a toy phone like a serious news reporter. He points it at Dad.
BOY: “पापा, Wi-Fi बंद क्यों हो जाता है?”
2–5 sec: Dad looks up from his real phone, confused.
DAD: “क्योंकि कभी-कभी आराम भी करता है!”
5–8 sec: The boy turns to Mom with a shocked expression.
BOY: “तो फिर उसका रिचार्ज कौन करता है?”
8–10 sec: Mom bursts into laughter while Dad quietly checks the router. The boy nods proudly as if he has solved a major mystery.

CAMERA:
Start with a medium-wide shot of the living room; quick gentle dolly-in as the boy asks his question; cut to Dad's confused close-up; finish with a wide three-shot capturing everyone's reaction.

VFX:
A tiny glowing question mark pops above the boy's head; a playful sparkle appears when he presents the toy phone; subtle comic bounce on Dad's confused expression.

SFX & MUSIC:
Light upbeat Indian family-comedy music, soft toy-phone beep, tiny “pop” for the question mark, and a short comedic drum beat after the boy's final question. Keep dialogue clear and foregrounded.

SCENE 02 — THE MYSTERY OF THE MISSING VEGETABLES (10 SECONDS)

VIDEO PROMPT:
Create a funny, energetic 10-second 3D animated family-comedy video in the same cozy Indian home and kitchen. Maintain exact character continuity: the same cute 3-year-old Indian boy with chubby cheeks, big curious brown eyes, short neatly combed black hair, yellow T-shirt and blue shorts; the same mother in a pastel kurta; and the same father in a casual T-shirt and track pants. Warm, colorful, high-quality family-friendly 3D animation, expressive faces, natural Hindi lip-sync and playful comic timing.

ACTION & DIALOGUE:
0–2 sec: Mom places a plate of vegetables on the dining table. The boy inspects it like a detective, hands on hips.
BOY: “मम्मी, ये हरी सब्ज़ियाँ इतनी सारी क्यों हैं?”
2–5 sec: Mom smiles and points to the plate.
MOM: “ताकि तुम ताकतवर बनो!”
5–8 sec: The boy flexes his tiny arms, then whispers suspiciously.
BOY: “लेकिन मम्मी… मैं तो पहले से ही बहुत ताकतवर हूँ!”
8–10 sec: He tries to lift a tiny cushion, struggles dramatically, and gently flops back onto the sofa. Dad laughs in the background while Mom gives him an amused look.

CAMERA:
Open with a medium shot of the plate and boy; pan up to his detective-like expression; cut to a close-up of his tiny flexing arms; end with a wide shot as he comically struggles with the cushion.

VFX:
A playful detective-style magnifying-glass glint appears over the vegetables; add a tiny cartoon muscle sparkle during his flex; use a soft, harmless squash-and-stretch effect as he flops onto the sofa.

SFX & MUSIC:
Light bouncy comedy music, a small “ding” as he examines the vegetables, a tiny heroic fanfare during the flex, and a soft “boing” as he lands. Keep dialogue clear and foregrounded.

item3.text:
SCENE 03 — WHO IS THE BOSS OF BEDTIME? (10 SECONDS)

VIDEO PROMPT:
Create a funny, energetic 10-second 3D animated family-comedy video in the same cozy Indian bedroom at bedtime. Maintain exact character continuity: the same cute 3-year-old Indian boy with chubby cheeks, big curious brown eyes, short neatly combed black hair, yellow T-shirt and blue shorts; the same mother in a pastel kurta; and the same father in a casual T-shirt and track pants. Warm, colorful, high-quality family-friendly 3D animation, expressive faces, natural Hindi lip-sync and playful comic timing.

ACTION & DIALOGUE:
0–2 sec: Mom gently tucks the boy into bed and switches on a small bedside lamp.
MOM: “चलो बेटा, अब सोने का टाइम!”
2–5 sec: The boy sits upright instantly, raises one finger and speaks like a tiny professor.
BOY: “एक आख़िरी सवाल… रात को सूरज कहाँ सोता है?”
5–8 sec: Dad peeks in from the doorway and answers sleepily.
DAD: “वो भी अपने घर जाता है!”
8–10 sec: The boy pulls the blanket up to his chin and whispers with a mischievous grin.
BOY: “तो कल उसे जल्दी उठाना… मुझे मिलना है!”
Mom and Dad exchange amused looks as the boy closes his eyes.

CAMERA:
Begin with a cozy medium-wide bedroom shot; slowly push in as the boy raises his finger; cut to Dad at the doorway for his answer; finish on a close-up of the boy's mischievous smile, then pull back to show the parents smiling.

VFX:
A tiny cartoon sun briefly appears in a thought bubble above the boy; the thought bubble gently fades as he snuggles under the blanket; warm, soft bedtime glow.

SFX & MUSIC:
Gentle playful bedtime music, soft blanket rustle, a tiny twinkle for the sun thought bubble, and a light comedic “ting” on the final punchline. Fade the music softly at the end. Keep dialogue clear and foregrounded.
